title: Article 38 — State to secure a social order for the promotion of welfare of the people

content.overview: Article 38 directs the State to strive to promote the welfare of the people by securing and protecting a social order in which justice — social, economic and political — informs all institutions of national life. The State shall, in particular, strive to minimise inequalities in income and eliminate inequalities in status, facilities and opportunities among individuals and groups among different areas or engaged in different vocations.
content.glance: State to promote welfare through a social order based on social, economic and political justice; minimise income inequalities; eliminate inequalities of status, facilities and opportunities.
content.study:
Article 38 is the umbrella welfare directive:
(1) Promote welfare by securing a social order informed by social, economic and political justice in all institutions of national life.
(2) (inserted by 44th Amendment) Strive to minimise inequalities in income and eliminate inequalities in status, facilities and opportunities (individuals and groups; areas; vocations).

Examination: three dimensions of justice; minimisation of inequalities; link to Arts 39–47 distributive and welfare directives.

sections.heading: Key directives
sections.body:
1. Social order informed by social, economic and political justice.
2. Minimise inequalities in income.
3. Eliminate inequalities in status, facilities and opportunities (individuals, groups, areas, vocations).

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 38 direct the State to do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 38 directs the State to strive to promote the welfare of the people by securing and protecting a social order in which justice — social, economic and political — informs all institutions of national life, and in particular to strive to minimise inequalities in income and eliminate inequalities in status, facilities and opportunities among individuals and groups among different areas or engaged in different vocations.

examTips: Social order + three justices; minimise/eliminate inequalities (44th Amendment).

keyTakeaways: Art 38: welfare social order; minimise inequalities.
